car.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production sprite for a top-down pixel-art arcade snake game, displayed in an 80 by 80 game-pixel square.
Primary request: one sporty compact car seen straight from overhead, pointing RIGHT (front bumper and headlights on the RIGHT, rear bumper on the LEFT). Adult arcade visual style, punchy and immediately readable.
Scene/backdrop: completely transparent alpha background, no road, no ground, no cast shadow outside the sprite.
Subject: one red compact car with a dark navy outline, light icy-blue windshield and rear window, four small dark tires, pale headlights on the right and tiny red-orange rear lights on the left. Clearly separated hood, roof and rear. No driver visible.
Style/medium: authentic simple low-resolution pixel art, as if drawn on a 32 by 32 pixel grid and enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Hard square pixel blocks, flat restrained shading, thick dark silhouette, no smooth vector curves or antialiasing, no 3D perspective.
Composition/framing: square canvas 1024 by 1024. Exactly one centered horizontal car, car occupies about 80 percent of canvas width and 52 percent of canvas height. Even transparent padding. Car's center exactly at canvas center. Orthographic top down, zero angle, right-facing.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no extra objects or effects. Genuine transparency. This is the final game texture, not a sprite-sheet preview or mockup.

beerBottle.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production beer-bottle collectible sprite for a top-down pixel-art arcade snake game, displayed in an 80 by 80 game-pixel square.
Primary request: exactly one recognizable upright beer bottle icon. The game will pulse its scale in code, so draw a single still bottle with no motion effects.
Scene/backdrop: genuine completely transparent alpha background. No surface or cast shadow outside the silhouette.
Subject: a classic amber-brown glass beer bottle with a short gold crown cap, narrow neck, rounded shoulders, wide lower body, a cream paper label with one simple dark burgundy horizontal stripe and NO TEXT, warm golden highlights on the glass. Dark navy pixel outline. Mature arcade aesthetic. Clearly a beer bottle rather than a potion flask or wine bottle.
Style/medium: simple low-resolution pixel art, as if drawn on a 32 by 32 pixel grid enlarged using nearest-neighbor, chunky hard square pixels and restrained flat shading. High contrast readable at small game size. Match a bright red top-down arcade car with dark navy outline and icy-blue windows.
Composition/framing: square 1024 by 1024 canvas. Bottle vertical and centered exactly, cap at top. Full bottle visible with even generous transparent padding. Bottle occupies about 35 percent of canvas width and 74 percent of canvas height. Front-view item icon. No perspective tilt.
Constraints: one bottle only. No lettering, no logo, no brand, no watermark, no sparkles or halo, no background square, no sprite sheet or mockup, no smooth vector edges. Keep alpha transparency.

storefront.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production background storefront strip for a top-down pixel-art parking-lot game.
Primary request: a very WIDE, LOW storefront facade of a small shop selling alcohol and snacks. Entire image is the facade, seen straight-on in classic top-down RPG convention. No ground or parking lot.
Canvas panoramic 3072x384 (8:1 aspect ratio) if possible. Facade will be displayed at 1280x160 pixels across the TOP of the game board. Keep all important design in the LOWER two thirds of image: the upper third must be simple flat dark navy fascia so score and pause HUD can overlay it.
Lower two-thirds: long warm lit shop window divided by neat dark frames, rows of small amber/green beer and wine bottles plus colorful crisp/chip bags and packaged snacks on shelves, a closed double glass entrance at center. Thin cream masonry frame and low light-gray sill. Recognizably an alcohol and snack store. Small burgundy sign strip centered above windows with ONLY exact text "ALKOHOL I PRZEKASKI" in bold cream block letters, positioned beneath the empty top HUD band. No brand names, logos or extra text.
Style: crisp chunky 2D pixel art matching a top-down arcade game, navy outlines, warm cream illumination, amber glass, restrained burgundy and teal details, simple flat shaded rectangular pixels. Pixel grid as though image was 320x40 pixels then enlarged nearest neighbor. No photorealism, no perspective recession, no isometric roof, no angled walls. Orthographic straight facade, no large building roof.
Composition: facade touches left and right image edges, no margins, no sky, no transparent background, no people, no cars, no trees. All opaque background. One continuous storefront from edge to edge, horizontally symmetrical composition about central doors. Leave top third calm and dark.
